links.outcome: Local retrospective performance of qXR vs radiologist reference standard for normal/abnormal CXR classification
links.effect: Sensitivity 99.7% and specificity 67.4% on 1040 local CXRs against two-radiologist ground truth.
links.quote: The CAD software had a sensitivity of 99.7% and a specificity of 67.4%.

links.outcome: AI performance across referral settings and X-ray manufacturers
links.effect: No statistically significant difference in performance across healthcare settings, age, gender, and X-ray manufacturer.
links.quote: The sub-group analysis showed no statistically significant difference in performance across healthcare settings, age, gender, and X-ray manufacturer.

screen.reason: Evaluates a commercial AI software (qXR) in a local NHS trust pre-deployment cohort to assess real-world diagnostic performance and subgroup robustness across clinical settings prior to adoption.
